lore.redomesticate.collar_tag: Use it on a pet to put on a collar. A named tag renames the pet, and the tag's pet enchantments are given to it. Swapping collars drops the old one, and a pet drops its collar when it dies.
lore.redomesticate.drum: A drum that commands all of your pets in a large area to stay, follow, or wander. Flux Power commands the pets of whoever placed it.
lore.redomesticate.feather_on_a_stick: Cast it like a fishing rod. Your nearest pet runs after the feather and plays with it, which is handy for leading pets where you want them.
lore.redomesticate.deed_of_ownership: A deed that transfers ownership of a pet to another player.
lore.redomesticate.pet_bed_black: A tamed pet that rests in it claims it as its own. If the pet dies, it comes back at its bed the next day. Use the bed to see whose it is.

lore.redomesticate.rotten_apple: Apples left to despawn on the ground can rot into these. Feed one to a Horse to turn it into a Zombie Horse, or to a Camel to turn it into a Camel Husk. Eating one poisons you.
lore.redomesticate.sinister_carrot: Use it on a Rabbit to turn it into a Killer Bunny, or on a Zombie Horse to turn it into a Skeleton Horse. Eating it withers you.
lore.redomesticate.wayward_lantern: Pets that were following you but got left behind in faraway areas find their way to a Wayward Lantern near you.
